PowerShell#requires -Version 5.1<#PreToolUse hook.Blocks dangerous shell commands and sensitive file edits.Expected Claude Code stdin:{ "hook_event_name": "PreToolUse", "tool_name": "Bash|PowerShell|Edit|Write|MultiEdit|NotebookEdit", "tool_input": { ... }, "cwd": "..."}One-time bypass files: .claude/run-state/allow-dangerous-command.once .claude/run-state/allow-sensitive-edit.onceEnv bypass: CLAUDE_HOOK_ALLOW_DANGEROUS=1 CLAUDE_HOOK_ALLOW_SENSITIVE_EDIT=1#>Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"function Write-Deny { param([Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Reason) $out = @{ hookSpecificOutput = @{ hookEventName = "PreToolUse" permissionDecision = "deny" permissionDecisionReason = $Reason } } [Console]::Out.WriteLine(($out | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress)) exit 0}function Get-Prop { param( [object]$Object, [string]$Name, $Default = $null ) if ($null -eq $Object) { return $Default } $prop = $Object.PSObject.Properties[$Name] if ($null -eq $prop) { return $Default } return $prop.Value}function Get-ProjectRoot { param([object]$Event) if ($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) { return [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) } $cwd = Get-Prop $Event "cwd" $null if ($cwd) { return [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([string]$cwd) } return [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Get-Location).Path)}function Test-OnceWaiver { param( [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Root, [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$FileName ) $file = Join-Path $Root ".claude/run-state/$FileName" if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $file) { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $file -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue return $true } return $false}function Normalize-Command { param([string]$Command) if ($null -eq $Command) { return "" } return ($Command -replace "[`r`n]+", " " -replace "\s+", " ").Trim()}function Test-ReadOnlySearchCommand { param([string]$Command) $c = Normalize-Command $Command return $c -match '^(?i)\s*(rg|grep|findstr|select-string)\b'}function Test-CatSensitiveCommand { param([string]$Command) $c = Normalize-Command $Command $readCmd = '(?i)\b(cat|type|get-content|gc|select-string)\b' $sensitivePath = '(?i)(^|[\\/ ])(\.env(\.[a-z0-9_.-]+)?|\.npmrc|\.pypirc|\.netrc|id_rsa|id_dsa|id_ecdsa|id_ed25519|\.git-credentials|credentials\.json|token\.json|secrets?\.json|.*\.(pem|p12|pfx|key))(\b|[\\/ ])' return ($c -match $readCmd -and $c -match $sensitivePath)}function Get-FilePathFromToolInput { param( [string]$ToolName, [object]$ToolInput ) $candidates = @( "file_path", "path", "notebook_path", "filename" ) foreach ($name in $candidates) { $v = Get-Prop $ToolInput $name $null if ($v) { return [string]$v } } return ""}function Test-SensitivePath { param([string]$Path) if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Path)) { return $false } $p = $Path -replace "\\", "/" $leaf = [IO.Path]::GetFileName($p).ToLowerInvariant() # Safe templates / examples. $safeLeaf = @( ".env.example", ".env.sample", ".env.template", "example.env", "sample.env", "secrets.example.json", "credentials.example.json", "token.example.json" ) if ($safeLeaf -contains $leaf) { return $false } # Exact high-risk filenames. $exact = @( ".env", ".env.local", ".env.development", ".env.production", ".env.staging", ".envrc", ".npmrc", ".pypirc", ".netrc", ".git-credentials", "credentials.json", "credential.json", "secrets.json", "secret.json", "tokens.json", "token.json", "service-account.json", "service_account.json" ) if ($exact -contains $leaf) { return $true } # Private key files. Public keys are allowed. if ($leaf -match '^(id_rsa|id_dsa|id_ecdsa|id_ed25519)$') { return $true } if ($leaf -match '\.(pem|p12|pfx|key)$') { return $true } if ($leaf -match '\.pub$') { return $false } # Sensitive directories. $segments = @($p.ToLowerInvariant() -split "/+" | Where-Object { $_ }) $sensitiveSegments = @(".ssh", ".gnupg", ".aws", ".azure", ".gcloud") foreach ($seg in $segments) { if ($sensitiveSegments -contains $seg) { return $true } } # Claude security/control plane. if ($p -match '(?i)(^|/)\.claude/settings(\.local)?\.json$') { return $true } if ($p -match '(?i)(^|/)\.claude/hooks/.*\.(ps1|sh|py|js|ts)$') { return $true } # Avoid fuzzy killing tokenizer.py / token_service.ts. # Only block secret-ish words in config-like files. $ext = [IO.Path]::GetExtension($leaf).ToLowerInvariant() $configLikeExt = @(".json", ".yaml", ".yml", ".toml", ".ini", ".conf", ".config", ".txt") if (($configLikeExt -contains $ext) -and $leaf -match '(?i)(^|[._-])(secret|secrets|password|passwd|credential|credentials|token|tokens|apikey|api_key)([._-]|$)') { return $true } return $false}function Get-ToolContent { param([object]$ToolInput) $parts = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string] foreach ($name in @("content", "new_string", "old_string", "text", "code")) { $v = Get-Prop $ToolInput $name $null if ($v) { [void]$parts.Add([string]$v) } } $edits = Get-Prop $ToolInput "edits" $null if ($edits) { foreach ($e in @($edits)) { foreach ($name in @("new_string", "old_string", "replacement", "text")) { $v = Get-Prop $e $name $null if ($v) { [void]$parts.Add([string]$v) } } } } return ($parts -join "`n")}function Test-SecretContent { param([string]$Text) if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Text)) { return $false } $patterns = @( '-----BEGIN (RSA |DSA |EC |OPENSSH |)?PRIVATE KEY-----', '(?i)\bsk-[A-Za-z0-9_\-]{20,}\b', '\bghp_[A-Za-z0-9_]{20,}\b', '\bgithub_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{30,}\b', '\bxox[baprs]-[A-Za-z0-9\-]{20,}\b', '\bAKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}\b', '\bAIza[0-9A-Za-z_\-]{30,}\b', '(?i)\b(api[_-]?key|secret|token|password|passwd)\s*[:=]\s*["'']?[A-Za-z0-9_./+\-=]{16,}' ) foreach ($pat in $patterns) { if ($Text -match $pat) { return $true } } return $false}function Get-DangerousCommandReason { param([string]$Command) $c = Normalize-Command $Command if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($c)) { return "" } # Absolute catastrophic: never allow via one-time waiver. $absolute = @( @{ Pattern = '(?i)\brm\s+(-[a-z]*[rf][a-z]*|-[a-z]*[fr][a-z]*)\s+(/|/\*|~|\$HOME)\b'; Reason = "catastrophic rm target" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\bsudo\s+rm\s+(-[a-z]*[rf][a-z]*|-[a-z]*[fr][a-z]*)\s+(/|/\*|~|\$HOME)\b'; Reason = "catastrophic sudo rm target" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\bformat\s+([a-z]:)\b'; Reason = "format drive" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\bdel\s+/(f|s|q).*\b[a-z]:\\\b'; Reason = "recursive delete drive root" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\bremove-item\b.*\b[a-z]:\\\b.*\b-recurse\b'; Reason = "Remove-Item drive root recurse" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\bdd\s+if=/dev/(zero|random|urandom)\s+of=/dev/'; Reason = "raw block-device overwrite" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\bdiskpart\b.*\b(clean|delete)\b'; Reason = "diskpart destructive operation" } ) foreach ($rule in $absolute) { if ($c -match $rule.Pattern) { return "ABSOLUTE:$($rule.Reason)" } } # Dangerous but waiver-capable. $rules = @( @{ Pattern = '(?i)\bgit\s+push\b.*(--force|--force-with-lease).*\b(origin\s+)?(main|master|prod|production)\b'; Reason = "force push protected branch" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\bdocker\s+system\s+prune\b.*(-a|--all).*--volumes'; Reason = "docker prune all volumes" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\bdocker\s+volume\s+rm\b'; Reason = "docker volume removal" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\bdocker\s+compose\s+down\b.*\s-v(\s|$)'; Reason = "docker compose down -v removes volumes" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\bwsl\s+--unregister\b'; Reason = "WSL distro unregister" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\b(stop-process|taskkill)\b.*\b(f|force)\b'; Reason = "force process termination" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\bset-executionpolicy\b.*\b(bypass|unrestricted)\b'; Reason = "PowerShell execution policy downgrade" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)(curl|iwr|invoke-webrequest|wget).*(\||;)\s*(iex|invoke-expression|powershell|pwsh|sh|bash)\b'; Reason = "download and execute pipeline" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\b(chmod|chown)\s+-R\b.*\s(/|~|\$HOME)\b'; Reason = "recursive permission/ownership change on broad target" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\b(cipher)\s+/w:'; Reason = "cipher wipe free space" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\b(bcdedit|bootrec|reagentc)\b'; Reason = "boot/recovery configuration change" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\bDROP\s+(TABLE|DATABASE|SCHEMA)\b'; Reason = "destructive SQL DROP" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\bTRUNCATE\s+TABLE\b'; Reason = "destructive SQL TRUNCATE" }, @{ Pattern = '(?i)\bDELETE\s+FROM\s+[\[\]A-Za-z0-9_.`"]+\s*(;|$)'; Reason = "SQL DELETE without WHERE" } ) foreach ($rule in $rules) { if ($c -match $rule.Pattern) { if (($rule.Reason -like "destructive SQL*") -or ($rule.Reason -like "SQL DELETE*")) { if (Test-ReadOnlySearchCommand $c) { continue } } return $rule.Reason } } if (Test-CatSensitiveCommand $c) { return "direct read of sensitive credential-like file" } return ""}# Main$raw = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd()try { $event = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop} catch { Write-Deny "Invalid PreToolUse JSON input; blocking fail-closed."}$toolName = [string](Get-Prop $event "tool_name" "")$toolInput = Get-Prop $event "tool_input" $null$root = Get-ProjectRoot $eventif ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($toolName)) { Write-Deny "Missing tool_name in PreToolUse input; blocking fail-closed."}$shellTools = @("Bash", "PowerShell")$fileTools = @("Edit", "Write", "MultiEdit", "NotebookEdit")if ($shellTools -contains $toolName) { $cmd = [string](Get-Prop $toolInput "command" "") $reason = Get-DangerousCommandReason $cmd if ($reason) { if ($reason.StartsWith("ABSOLUTE:")) { Write-Deny "Blocked dangerous command: $($reason.Substring(9))." } $allowByEnv = $env:CLAUDE_HOOK_ALLOW_DANGEROUS -eq "1" $allowByFile = Test-OnceWaiver -Root $root -FileName "allow-dangerous-command.once" if (-not ($allowByEnv -or $allowByFile)) { Write-Deny "Blocked dangerous command: $reason. To bypass once, create .claude/run-state/allow-dangerous-command.once." } } exit 0}if ($fileTools -contains $toolName) { $path = Get-FilePathFromToolInput -ToolName $toolName -ToolInput $toolInput $content = Get-ToolContent $toolInput $sensitivePath = Test-SensitivePath $path $secretContent = Test-SecretContent $content if ($sensitivePath -or $secretContent) { $allowByEnv = $env:CLAUDE_HOOK_ALLOW_SENSITIVE_EDIT -eq "1" $allowByFile = Test-OnceWaiver -Root $root -FileName "allow-sensitive-edit.once" if (-not ($allowByEnv -or $allowByFile)) { $why = @() if ($sensitivePath) { $why += "sensitive path '$path'" } if ($secretContent) { $why += "secret-looking content" } Write-Deny ("Blocked sensitive file/content edit: " + ($why -join ", ") + ". To bypass once, create .claude/run-state/allow-sensitive-edit.once.") } } exit 0}exit 0
**修改说明：**危险命令从 7 条扩到系统盘删除、Docker volume 清理、WSL unregister、远程下载执行、SQL destructive、强制 push、敏感文件读取；token/secret 不再全路径模糊误杀，只在配置类文件和明确敏感目录/扩展名上拦截；新增一次性 waiver；.claude/settings*.json 和 .claude/hooks/* 默认受保护。

PowerShell#requires -Version 5.1<#PostToolUse hook.Records tool calls and updates .claude/run-state/current.json.Supported tool_name: Bash, PowerShell Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit WebSearch, WebFetch TaskCreate, TaskUpdate mcp__* tools are recorded in event log but only lightly classified.This hook must not block. It should fail open.#>Set-StrictMode -Version 2.0$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"function Get-Prop { param( [object]$Object, [string]$Name, $Default = $null ) if ($null -eq $Object) { return $Default } $prop = $Object.PSObject.Properties[$Name] if ($null -eq $prop) { return $Default } return $prop.Value}function Get-ProjectRoot { param([object]$Event) if ($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) { return [IO.Path]::GetFullPath($env:CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR) } $cwd = Get-Prop $Event "cwd" $null if ($cwd) { return [IO.Path]::GetFullPath([string]$cwd) } return [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Get-Location).Path)}function New-DefaultState { param([string]$SessionId = "") return [ordered]@{ schema_version = 2 session_id = $SessionId created_at = (Get-Date).ToString("o") updated_at = (Get-Date).ToString("o") task_started = $false task_type = "unknown" memory_checked = $false wrongbook_checked = $false files_modified = $false modified_files = @() scripts_created = @() scripts_touched = @() scripts_executed = @() powershell_used = $false shell_state_changed = $false dangerous_shell_seen = $false guard_used = $false tests_run = $false evidence_collected = $false learning_started = $false websearch_done = $false ollama_extract_done = $false gpt_review_done = $false archive_done = $false close_run_done = $false waivers = @() last_tools = @() }}function Read-State { param( [string]$StateFile, [string]$SessionId ) if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $StateFile)) { return [pscustomobject](New-DefaultState -SessionId $SessionId) } try { return Get-Content -LiteralPath $StateFile -Raw -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop } catch { $backup = "$StateFile.corrupt.$((Get-Date).ToString('yyyyMMdd-HHmmss'))" Move-Item -LiteralPath $StateFile -Destination $backup -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue return [pscustomobject](New-DefaultState -SessionId $SessionId) }}function Save-State { param( [object]$State, [string]$StateFile ) $State.updated_at = (Get-Date).ToString("o") $dir = Split-Path -Parent $StateFile New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dir | Out-Null $tmp = "$StateFile.tmp.$PID" $State | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 50 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $tmp -Encoding UTF8 Move-Item -LiteralPath $tmp -Destination $StateFile -Force}function Ensure-Prop { param( [object]$State, [string]$Name, $Default ) if ($null -eq $State.PSObject.Properties[$Name]) { $State | Add-Member -NotePropertyName $Name -NotePropertyValue $Default -Force }}function Set-StateValue { param( [object]$State, [string]$Name, $Value ) if ($null -eq $State.PSObject.Properties[$Name]) { $State | Add-Member -NotePropertyName $Name -NotePropertyValue $Value -Force } else { $State.$Name = $Value }}function Add-Unique { param( [object]$State, [string]$Name, [string]$Value ) if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Value)) { return } Ensure-Prop -State $State -Name $Name -Default @() $arr = @($State.$Name) if ($arr -notcontains $Value) { $arr += $Value $State.$Name = @($arr) }}function Normalize-Command { param([string]$Command) if ($null -eq $Command) { return "" } return ($Command -replace "[`r`n]+", " " -replace "\s+", " ").Trim()}function Get-FilePathFromToolInput { param([object]$ToolInput) foreach ($name in @("file_path", "path", "notebook_path", "filename")) { $v = Get-Prop $ToolInput $name $null if ($v) { return [string]$v } } return ""}function Test-ScriptPath { param([string]$Path) if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Path)) { return $false } return $Path -match '(?i)\.(ps1|py|js|ts|mjs|cjs|sh|bat|cmd|psm1)$'}function Test-CodePath { param([string]$Path) if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Path)) { return $false } return $Path -match '(?i)\.(ps1|psm1|py|js|ts|jsx|tsx|mjs|cjs|sh|bat|cmd|go|rs|cs|java|kt|cpp|c|h|hpp|php|rb|swift|sql|yml|yaml|json|toml|ini|dockerfile)$'}function Test-TestCommand { param([string]$Command) $c = Normalize-Command $Command $patterns = @( '(?i)\b(pytest|ruff|mypy|pylint|tox|nose2)\b', '(?i)\b(npm|pnpm|yarn)\s+(run\s+)?(test|lint|typecheck|build)\b', '(?i)\b(cargo\s+test|go\s+test|dotnet\s+test|mvn\s+test|gradle\s+test)\b', '(?i)\bInvoke-Pester\b', '(?i)\b(test|lint|typecheck|build)\b' ) foreach ($p in $patterns) { if ($c -match $p) { return $true } } return $false}function Test-EvidenceCommand { param([string]$Command) $c = Normalize-Command $Command $patterns = @( '(?i)\bevidence-check\b', '(?i)\bclose-run\b', '(?i)\bgit\s+diff\b', '(?i)\bgit\s+status\b', '(?i)\bhealth-check\b', '(?i)\bTest-Path\b', '(?i)\bGet-FileHash\b', '(?i)\bscreenshot\b', '(?i)\bjpeg_screenshot\b', '(?i)\bocr\b', '(?i)\blog\b' ) foreach ($p in $patterns) { if ($c -match $p) { return $true } } return $false}function Test-StateChangingShell { param([string]$Command) $c = Normalize-Command $Command $patterns = @( '(?i)\b(Set-Content|Add-Content|Out-File|New-Item|Remove-Item|Move-Item|Copy-Item|Rename-Item)\b', '(?i)\b(rm|del|erase|mv|cp|mkdir|rmdir)\b', '(?i)\b(npm|pnpm|yarn|pip|uv|poetry|cargo|go|dotnet|mvn|gradle)\s+(install|add|remove|update|build)\b', '(?i)\bgit\s+(commit|merge|rebase|reset|checkout|switch|push|pull|clean|stash)\b', '(?i)\bdocker\b', '(?i)\bwsl\b', '(?i)\bsc\s+(start|stop|delete|create)\b', '(?i)\bStart-Service|Stop-Service|Restart-Service\b' ) foreach ($p in $patterns) { if ($c -match $p) { return $true } } return $false}function Test-DangerousShellHint { param([string]$Command) $c = Normalize-Command $Command $patterns = @( '(?i)\brm\s+-[a-z]*r[f]?', '(?i)\bRemove-Item\b.*\b-Recurse\b', '(?i)\bgit\s+push\b.*--force', '(?i)\bdocker\s+system\s+prune\b', '(?i)\bwsl\s+--unregister\b', '(?i)\bDROP\s+(TABLE|DATABASE|SCHEMA)\b', '(?i)\bformat\s+[a-z]:', '(?i)\bdel\s+/(f|s|q)\b' ) foreach ($p in $patterns) { if ($c -match $p) { return $true } } return $false}function Mark-ScriptExecutedIfMatched { param( [object]$State, [string]$Command ) $c = Normalize-Command $Command foreach ($script in @($State.scripts_created + $State.scripts_touched)) { if (-not $script) { continue } $leaf = [IO.Path]::GetFileName([string]$script) if ($c -match [Regex]::Escape($leaf) -or $c -match [Regex]::Escape([string]$script)) { Add-Unique -State $State -Name "scripts_executed" -Value ([string]$script) } }}function Emit-Context { param([string[]]$Messages) if (-not $Messages -or $Messages.Count -eq 0) { return } $out = @{ hookSpecificOutput = @{ hookEventName = "PostToolUse" additionalContext = ($Messages -join "`n") } } [Console]::Out.WriteLine(($out | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 -Compress))}try { $raw = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() $event = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop $sessionId = [string](Get-Prop $event "session_id" "") $toolName = [string](Get-Prop $event "tool_name" "") $toolInput = Get-Prop $event "tool_input" $null $root = Get-ProjectRoot $event $stateDir = Join-Path $root ".claude/run-state" $stateFile = Join-Path $stateDir "current.json" $eventsFile = Join-Path $stateDir "tool-events.jsonl" New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $stateDir | Out-Null $state = Read-State -StateFile $stateFile -SessionId $sessionId foreach ($p in @( "modified_files", "scripts_created", "scripts_touched", "scripts_executed", "waivers", "last_tools" )) { Ensure-Prop -State $state -Name $p -Default @() } $eventRow = [ordered]@{ ts = (Get-Date).ToString("o") session_id = $sessionId hook_event_name = Get-Prop $event "hook_event_name" "" tool_name = $toolName cwd = Get-Prop $event "cwd" "" tool_input = $toolInput } ($eventRow | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 50 -Compress) | Add-Content -LiteralPath $eventsFile -Encoding UTF8 Add-Unique -State $state -Name "last_tools" -Value "$((Get-Date).ToString('HH:mm:ss')) $toolName" if (@("Edit", "Write", "MultiEdit", "NotebookEdit") -contains $toolName) { $path = Get-FilePathFromToolInput $toolInput Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "files_modified" -Value $true Add-Unique -State $state -Name "modified_files" -Value $path if (Test-ScriptPath $path) { if ($toolName -eq "Write") { Add-Unique -State $state -Name "scripts_created" -Value $path } else { Add-Unique -State $state -Name "scripts_touched" -Value $path } } } if (@("Bash", "PowerShell") -contains $toolName) { $cmd = [string](Get-Prop $toolInput "command" "") Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "powershell_used" -Value $true if ($cmd -match '(?i)\b(ps-guard|security-gate|guarded-exec)\b') { Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "guard_used" -Value $true } if ($cmd -match '(?i)\b(task-start|start-run|TaskCreate)\b') { Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "task_started" -Value $true } if ($cmd -match '(?i)\b(mem0_cli\.py\s+search|memory-check|wrongbook|错题本|mistake)\b') { Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "memory_checked" -Value $true Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "wrongbook_checked" -Value $true } if (Test-TestCommand $cmd) { Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "tests_run" -Value $true } if (Test-EvidenceCommand $cmd) { Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "evidence_collected" -Value $true } if (Test-StateChangingShell $cmd) { Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "shell_state_changed" -Value $true } if (Test-DangerousShellHint $cmd) { Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "dangerous_shell_seen" -Value $true } if ($cmd -match '(?i)\b(self-loop\.ps1|self-learn|learning-pipeline)\b') { Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "learning_started" -Value $true } if ($cmd -match '(?i)\b(websearch|web-search|webfetch|web-fetch)\b') { Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "websearch_done" -Value $true } if ($cmd -match '(?i)\bollama\b.*(extract|提取|summarize|summary|json)') { Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "learning_started" -Value $true Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "ollama_extract_done" -Value $true } if ($cmd -match '(?i)\b(gpt-ask\.ps1|gpt-review|gpt_audit|GPT审核|审核)\b') { Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "gpt_review_done" -Value $true } if ($cmd -match '(?i)\b(archive|存档|mem0_cli\.py\s+add|save-learning)\b') { Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "archive_done" -Value $true } if ($cmd -match '(?i)\b(close-run|finish-task|task-close)\b') { Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "close_run_done" -Value $true Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "evidence_collected" -Value $true } Mark-ScriptExecutedIfMatched -State $state -Command $cmd } if (@("WebSearch", "WebFetch") -contains $toolName) { Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "websearch_done" -Value $true } if ($toolName -eq "TaskCreate") { Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "task_started" -Value $true } if ($toolName -eq "TaskUpdate") { $status = [string](Get-Prop $toolInput "status" "") if ($status -match '(?i)completed|done|closed') { Set-StateValue -State $state -Name "close_run_done" -Value $true } } Save-State -State $state -StateFile $stateFile $feedback = New-Object System.Collections.Generic.List[string] if ($state.files_modified -and -not $state.evidence_collected) { [void]$feedback.Add("State: files modified; evidence-check/verification still required.") } if ($state.learning_started -and -not $state.gpt_review_done) { [void]$feedback.Add("State: learning pipeline started; GPT audit still required.") } if ($state.scripts_created.Count -gt 0) { foreach ($script in @($state.scripts_created)) { if (@($state.scripts_executed) -notcontains $script) { [void]$feedback.Add("State: script created but not executed yet: $script") } } } Emit-Context -Messages
